THE ONE BACKEND BUG: `defaults_seeded_v2` flag is stripped by PATCH /api/quotes/{id} because it is not declared as a field on the `QuoteInputs` Pydantic model — `body.inputs.model_dump()` at routes/quotes.py:574 silently drops it. Result: every admin PATCH loses the flag; the very next GET re-seeds all zero'd fields to defaults (verified 120 re-appearing after admin zeroed custom_clearance_aud). This means admin can never persist a $0 value for custom_clearance / AU-delivery / any of the 5 USD ancillaries / fx_adjustment_pct / intl_txn_pct / duty_pct / gst_pct. Non-zero overrides are unaffected. Two pre-existing (iter_13) console warnings still present: 'Unexpected text node' + RN-web Image resizeMode/tintColor deprecations — non-blocking, out of scope.

critical.issue: defaults_seeded_v2 flag is stripped on every PATCH because it is NOT declared as a field on QuoteInputs (routes/quotes.py:66). At line 574 `patch['inputs'] = body.inputs.model_dump()` writes the Pydantic-validated dict which drops unknown keys, so the flag disappears from the persisted document. Next GET (routes/quotes.py:512) then treats the quote as legacy-unseeded and re-seeds all falsy defaults, silently overwriting any admin-set $0 or 0%. Reproduced: created freelance quote → GET (stamps flag) → PATCH inputs with custom_clearance_aud=0.0 → GET → value is 120.0 again. Fix options: (1) add `defaults_seeded_v2: Optional[bool] = None` to QuoteInputs; (2) merge the flag back in patch_quote after model_dump; (3) set `model_config = ConfigDict(extra='allow')` on QuoteInputs.

critical_code_review_comments: routes/quotes.py line 574 `patch['inputs'] = body.inputs.model_dump()` is the ROOT CAUSE of the defaults_seeded_v2 loss. Any input field the compute engine or the backfill code writes to `inputs` but that is NOT declared on the QuoteInputs Pydantic model will be silently dropped on every PATCH. Consider auditing all `inputs.*` keys touched by backend code and cross-referencing against QuoteInputs.

Backfill guard at routes/quotes.py:512 correctly checks `if not inputs.get('defaults_seeded_v2')` — the logic is right, but the flag never survives long enough for the guard to fire on the second GET after any PATCH.

Backfill uses `if not inputs.get(field)` which treats 0/None/missing identically — this is intentional per spec ('only fields that are 0/null get seeded'). BUT combined with the flag-loss bug above, this means admin-zeroed values are silently overwritten on next open. The two bugs together produce a data-integrity issue.

rca_of_issue: BUG: defaults_seeded_v2 lost on PATCH. Reproduction: (1) POST /api/quotes/freelance → get quote id; (2) GET /api/quotes/{id} → backfill stamps `inputs.defaults_seeded_v2 = true` in Mongo; (3) PATCH /api/quotes/{id} with body `{inputs: {...current inputs..., custom_clearance_aud: 0.0}}` → server calls `body.inputs.model_dump()` which strips defaults_seeded_v2 because it's not a declared field on the QuoteInputs Pydantic model; the entire `inputs` sub-document is replaced without the flag; (4) GET /api/quotes/{id} → `inputs.get('defaults_seeded_v2')` is falsy → backfill loop runs again → `not inputs.get('custom_clearance_aud')` is True (0 is falsy in Python) → re-seeds to 120.0. Mitigation (fastest, backwards-compatible): add `defaults_seeded_v2: Optional[bool] = None` to QuoteInputs at routes/quotes.py:66. Alternative: preserve q.get('inputs', {}).get('defaults_seeded_v2') and merge it back onto `patch['inputs']` inside patch_quote before the update_one call. The bug is HIGH-severity because it silently invalidates any admin decision to zero-out one of the seeded defaults — a data-integrity issue, not just a UI glitch.
